text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to keep hope alive with my own hands.
That's what I wished for when entering this race, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Far from giving them hope, I ended up
making all my fans sad..."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Does someone like me really have the right
to become someone else's hope?
choice_data_list: Then should we leave it to one of the other girls?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Bringing joy and smiles.
If that were all, it wouldn't have to be me.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the one who will connect everyone's hearts into a circle
and bring hope—is me.”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Because that is the wish I swore on that day,
and the very reason I run."
choice_data_list: With that feeling in your heart, you're sure to win!
Then let's rethink how we can win again.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
We will definitely win next time. And this time,
I will keep hope alive with my own hands!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm sure there are mountains of issues to address.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Still, together, I know we can overcome this.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes, I'll definitely have become one.
A presence that brings hope...!
